title: Sample Profile
description: See an example OpenStack community member profile and the kinds of information members can share about their interests and contributions.
body:
A Sample Profile

Below is a sample public profile of an OpenStack Foundation Individual Member. This should give you an example of how your profile may appear depending on the information you provide.

To edit your own details:   login to your OpenStack profile.
